question: Explain why a metal spoon feels colder than a wooden spoon at the same room temperature.

markscheme_points.text: Metal is a better thermal conductor than wood
So heat flows from the hand to the metal faster
The skin cools more quickly, which is sensed as colder

student_answer: Metal conducts heat better than wood, so it takes heat away from your hand faster and your skin gets cooler.
